title: Cellgroup Bible Study session at Weegol's Garden
paragraphs: Cellgroup Bible Study session at Weegol's Garden

I thank God for the lives of these people as they continue to grow their relationship with God. As i continue to minister to them, they were able to open up and become my personal friends and disciples for the ways on following Christ Jesus.

Thank you my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for the continued support and paving the way of Christ to the lives of your staffs. May God continue to pour out blessings on you, your family and your businesses, as you exhalt Him high to glorify His name.
All these for the Glory of God!
